name: KYMA Frequency MCP
tagline: Search KYMA369's public frequency library and open sets in the free app.
description: A remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for discovering KYMA369's public frequency library by keyword, Hz, or wellness intent, then opening user-initiated playback links in the free KYMA app. It provides catalog discovery only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, or prevention claims.

env.name: KYMA_MCP_ANON_KEY
env.description: KYMA public MCP access key; copy the current published value from the official KYMA MCP documentation.

install.notes: Use KYMA's official MCP page for current configuration and public frequency-library scope: https://kyma369.com/mcp
